mismatches.name: reproducible
mismatches.claim: same seed / same code → identical results
mismatches.problem: predicate does not contain any keyword for its own name 'reproducible' — tests a different property
mismatches.branch_preview: if not has_prereg: |         return {"level": "V1", "reason": "≥1 evidence edge but no preregistered protocol"}

mismatches.name: preregistered
mismatches.claim: claim's verdict is enforced by a gate (fail-closed)
mismatches.problem: predicate does not contain any keyword for its own name 'preregistered' — tests a different property
mismatches.branch_preview: if not has_receipt: |         return {"level": "V3", "reason": "cross-checked, no receipt"}

mismatches.name: cross-checked
mismatches.claim: at least two independent reads of the evidence agree
mismatches.problem: predicate does not contain any keyword for its own name 'cross-checked' — tests a different property
mismatches.branch_preview: if not redteam_passed: |         return {"level": "V4", "reason": "receipt present, redteam not verified"}
